scientific_integrity: The general polynomial-truth-table random model and the false proposed cycle expression are due to Horak and Semaev (2026). The full corrected all-n count is derived here by Boolean relation composition. No independent audit or comprehensive historical-priority review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for independent uniform two-input Boolean relation truth tables on each labelled edge of C_n, n>=3; no claims for biased constraints, other support graphs, or number-of-solutions distributions. Finite tests do not prove the universal formula; the integer transition identity does.
title: Exact consistency enumeration for random binary constraints on cycles
